coverage.reason: Read-only operator tooling: exercise account/config/response redaction, pagination, authorization request headers, API failures, exact integer counts, source/deployment drift, and refusal of incomplete realm/tenant/region/count inventories. Fixture integration verifies every request is a metadata read or aggregation and no production payload is persisted. No game client, rules, backend authority or build dependency changes; emulator suites are not affected.

Document observed snapshot/import/restore results, account and storage test coverage, integrations/access status, and remaining migration/cutover gates. Explicitly distinguish isolated rehearsal from live deployment; no gameplay or permission changes.

Read-only fixed-time source export and isolated local PostgreSQL import/restore. Test interrupted-page recovery, typed values, missing parent documents, cursor order, count/checksum/privacy failures, adaptive page limits, identity/hash completeness, overwrite refusal and complete real-database restore comparisons. No live writes, routes, scheduler or Firebase authority changes; emulator suites do not exercise the new PostgreSQL target.

PostgreSQL storage and pinned local dependencies, selected only by the isolated game rehearsal. Test typed values, ordering/cursors, literal FieldPath updates, conditional bulk cleanup, atomic rollback/change records, serializable callback transactions and path-locked blind writes with concurrent creation/merge/increment. Actual game initialization and season/PvP receipt tests reproduce large parallel map writes; worker and account tests exercise shared transaction behavior. No live backend selection changes. Pin web-push 3.6.7 and independently decrypt its encrypted request payload with browser fixture keys.

Account migration library, with an owner-only LAN rehearsal prepared separately from live login: verify imported hashes, UID/provider preservation, revoked sessions including verification races, one-use actions, Google binding/nonce/PKCE, registration and reauthentication. HTTP tests exercise host/origin/CSRF, cookies, size/concurrency, private errors and return-path handling. Real preview tests cover isolated source preservation and no privileged-runtime startup. No live Firebase account or game-client changes.

Prepare locked local dependencies and an isolated fixture-only PostgreSQL database in the static job when the reviewed selection needs it. Preserve all required checks and emulator selection. Exercise workflow selection/push protections and the actual synthetic PostgreSQL test commands; GitHub independently verifies fresh-runner setup.

Prepare an expiring private account test with exactly one copied owner account, a read-only profile-existence receipt, loopback-only listener, LAN/host gating, overwritten trusted proxy header, blocked resets/registration/email, separate least-privilege PostgreSQL role and hardened OS service. Tests prove isolation, UID preservation, no snapshot overwrite, authenticated receipt access, expiry and runtime ownership refusal. Prepared Caddy adaptation and systemd unit are validated locally; actual administrator installation and real Google sign-in are separately verified. Existing game routes, player data, workers, monitoring and publisher remain unchanged.

Centralize existing SDK bindings without changing Firebase default references or game handlers. Register all 150 real exports in an explicitly isolated PostgreSQL runtime; no server/worker starts on import. Test current-realm initialization, actual PvP event deduplication, season closing/claims and unauthenticated/unverified/stale release rejection. Durable local jobs test atomic per-change dispatch despite out-of-order commits, immutable event snapshots, retry receipts, stale/late-worker write fencing, dead letters, bounded restart catch-up and New York DST. Existing Firebase emulator suites independently cover the shared entry point, season service, realm readiness and email authorization; external integrations remain disabled only in rehearsal. Retain concurrency slots for timed-out handlers until they actually settle, fence writes on shutdown/expiry, and run the bounded worker loop on synthetic PostgreSQL events. Optional bounded local translation provider retains the default Firebase provider and shared chat authorization/cache/allowance logic; include source emulator translation checks and real PostgreSQL provider isolation tests. Extract the unchanged incoming-army payload for both notification transports. Retain Firebase delivery by default; validate existing per-device receipts, active-session device cleanup and notification contracts with the original emulators.

Owner-only local HTTP and application permissions: pin the deployed/repository rule policy and protected-field contracts; real PostgreSQL tests exercise authorized and denied reads/writes, atomic checks, typed-input abuse, optimistic conflicts, cookies, origin/CSRF, source-IP spoofing, bounded independent listeners, deadline fencing and stale-session rejection. Existing rule emulators independently check the source profile/economy/session, cosmetic flag, army-read and verified-email contracts. Full differential policy and workflow parity remain a production acceptance gate. Reproduce a 600 KB imported save through the actual HTTP transport, retain the smaller callable budget, reject oversized writes, and prove operational diagnostics omit payloads and error messages.

Opt-in private browser transport; default Firebase initialization and live game URLs stay unchanged. Test real cookie/data protocol, transforms, typed timestamps, scoped cursors, transaction retries, listener aggregation and stopped/old-session responses. Isolate private update checks/PWA/storage and exclude no-store/private auth responses from caches. Existing login, realm admission, email and cache contract tests cover shared client dependencies; standard build/artifact checks cover the new static file. Desktop/landscape preview is a separate manual gate before production readiness. Exercise 30 simultaneous startup calls through a six-request client queue, cap pending requests, and reject queued/in-flight results on disposal so startup does not overwhelm the twelve-request server admission limit. Explicit private-only Web Push module uses an expiring native subscription key and worker under the private path. Test permission, registration scope, matching key, unsubscribe, expiry, foreground isolation and cold-click target preservation; public Firebase/PWA remain default.

Fresh exact private game copy, source-preserving ingress adaptation, HMAC-only integration, explicit owner/expiry/LAN boundary, least-privilege service preparation, private static serving and independent browser storage. Test real schema copy/overwrite refusal, source integrity, secret restrictions, route guards, static traversal/symlink rejection and cache isolation. Installer hashes/config guards and Caddy/systemd syntax are reviewed separately; administrator installation and real copied-city gameplay remain explicit acceptance checks. No workers or external side-effect integrations activated. Test the scoped request-limit repair, installed-file/config checksum refusal, unexpected-route rejection and rollback after a failed proxy reload; preserve all data and live routes. Subsequent preview repairs also verify the previous installed repair receipt and the browser adapter hash. Extend the same checksum/rollback guarded private repair to the installed palette; verify all prepared files install and roll back, retaining live routes and data. Explicit translation startup validates the prepared owner/schema/expiry and durable allowance; default private startup remains disconnected, with stop on shutdown.

The selected existing auth validator omitted the current cosmetics client dependency and failed before reaching its assertions. Load the actual dependency in its isolated VM to restore email/Google/session coverage without changing game behavior or stubbing away the requirement.

Finite worker rehearsal only on an expiring migration_game_preview copy, with a consistent private dump before execution and a hard shutdown limit. Pin the actual 26-handler inventory, omit notification delivery, test bounded dispatch/concurrency, durable retries, expiry and shutdown write fencing, aggregate status and error redaction. No production role, public endpoint or external provider activation. Allowlist static handler labels, operational error codes and aggregate outcome counters; prove private identifiers/messages, arbitrary codes and getters cannot enter worker diagnostics.

Prepare an expiring private worker service for the copied game only, after a consistent dump. Require a separate restricted PostgreSQL/OS role, no schema creation or account-table access, root-owned runtime and systemd credentials, AF_UNIX-only private networking, bounded memory/restart/shutdown, fresh aggregate health after startup and restart, and fail-closed expiry. Test unsafe configurations, real owner-role refusal, grant scopes, health acceptance and private status files. Actual administrator installation/restart remains a separate acceptance check; public routes and production providers are unchanged. Reproduce private preparation umask 077, make only the nonsecret program directory traversable by its restricted service account, preserve root-only credentials, reject symlinks and checksum/config changes during the scoped installed-permission repair.

Add a consistent shared-snapshot PostgreSQL account/game archive to the existing encrypted host backup before restic runs. Test concurrent changes during snapshot export, every-row fingerprints, actual synthetic restore, identity-sequence preservation, archive corruption and target rejection, private file modes, source-list preservation, installer refusal of changed scripts and failed-restore retention. The root installer must restore the actual copied database as its restricted owner and compare every table before modifying the existing backup; an initial full sandboxed local/off-site run remains an operational acceptance check. Existing cloud destination, retention and backup-failure uptime alerts are preserved; no game balance, active-world or Firebase behavior changes. Verify scoped dependency exclusions with a real encrypted Restic backup/restore when installed: installed nested dependencies remain recoverable while development dependencies and credential exclusions remain omitted. Existing installer repair/rollback and shared-snapshot recovery coverage still applies.

Opt-in account-email dispatcher with an explicitly allowlisted Resend rehearsal transport; importing code starts no service or email. Real PostgreSQL and synthetic HTTP tests cover concurrent claims, provider acceptance before process failure, immutable idempotent retries, stale completion fencing, quota/network failures, expired/consumed/superseded/disabled-account actions, bounded attempts, token-payload cleanup, fixed provider errors and recipient/URL restrictions. Existing local auth action/session tests cover shared one-use reset and verification semantics. No real emails or provider credentials are used by tests; production Firebase behavior is unchanged. The controlled owner-email command refuses changed recipient/account count, expired previews and existing pending mail. Test the explicit LAN-only account-action opt-in, preserved blocked email-request/registration routes, default production action-page behavior, and source/config/privilege rollback after failed protected-service restart. Desktop and landscape action-page inspection is recorded separately; Ubuntu installation and an explicitly approved real email remain operational gates.

Prepare an uninstalled expiring native HTTP payment adapter for isolated PostgreSQL. Exercise raw SDK signatures, explicit live/test separation, wrong account/host/path and duplicate headers, bounded bodies/concurrency/deadlines, late-write fencing, real atomic wallet/order receipts, lost checkout responses, simultaneous/restarted delivery replay, provider failures, refund deduplication, overflow rollback and concurrent game credit. Providers, accounts and keys are synthetic; no listener persists or external checkout/webhook is activated. Existing payment contract and Firebase emulator suites independently preserve shared business behavior. An explicit lifecycle gate also rejects requests and late transaction commits after provider rehearsal shutdown.

Private migration acceptance exposed opaque generic themed buttons covering already-loaded Inner Castle building sprites. Exclude only the existing building hit targets from generic button paint so the dedicated transparent map controls remain authoritative. Existing palette and estate asset/layout checks cover shared presentation contracts; desktop and landscape browser checks verify loaded images, transparent selected/unselected controls and visible building art. No gameplay, balance, data, prices or server authority changes.

Prepare an expiring owner-allowlisted account-mail system service. Real PostgreSQL and synthetic provider tests cover empty queue/no send, password-free account projection, restart replay avoidance, single active send, abort on shutdown/expiry, stop after delayed database claims, durable retry recovery, private health counts/backlog failures and restricted-role refusal. Installer tests exercise exact configuration/recipient/expiry gates, minimal column grants, empty-queue startup/restart checks and removal of only newly installed service identities/files on failure. Preserve existing encrypted backup sources and add only this service; no message is queued, live route changed or real provider request made by tests. Actual administrator installation and restricted-runtime startup are separate acceptance checks; production email and external delivery alerts remain migration gates. Reproduce the actual private umask 077 at installation; prove the top-level runtime and nested folders become traversable while credential directories stay private.

Prepare an explicitly invoked test-key-only provider rehearsal in a fresh disposable payment schema for the existing approved tester/pack. Real PostgreSQL and synthetic Stripe SDK/HTTP tests exercise distinct metadata purpose/marker isolation, actual signatures, wrong mode/account/provider evidence, duplicate credit, unchanged playable profile, owner restriction, stop/expiry including delayed provider reads, scoped Checkout cleanup, private operator-file permissions and secret-preserving CLI startup checks. Existing native payment tests cover request limits/late commits; existing test payment unit/emulator suites preserve the shared business contract. Actual sandbox Checkout and automatic provider delivery are operator acceptance checks after committing and validating; no production endpoint/key/wallet is activated.

Prepare owner-only local Google Translation using a dedicated credential and at most 1,000 characters reserved atomically from the live project allowance only after explicit approval. Real PostgreSQL tests cover concurrent source/local reservations, idempotent receipts, Unicode, no refund/reset, cache/access rechecks, fixed JWT/provider endpoints and scope, stop/expiry during waits, default disabled integrations, and credential/installer rollback fixtures. Existing Firebase translation emulator covers unchanged source visibility/cache/monthly rules through the shared entry point. No new UI, actual Google request, cloud access grant or live ledger write is performed by validation. Reproduce systemd root-owned 0440 ACL credential delivery and accept it only in the exact root-owned read-only service directory; reject arbitrary shared files, writable/non-root directories, changed ownership, symlink resolution, oversize and wrong-service paths.

Optional owner-only native browser notification preview. Real PostgreSQL tests exercise encrypted payload decryption, known browser-provider endpoints, scope/key validation, new-only outbox filtering, copied FCM token isolation, durable five-attempt cap, partial per-device receipt retries/restarts, gone subscriptions and transport shutdown. Browser fixtures cover exact private worker scope, permission/key/expiry handling, safe foreground and notification clicks including cold-start targets, and no public fetch/cache interception. Service fixtures verify systemd credential ACL restrictions, role scope, program permissions, changed-client refusal and restoration. Existing server emulators retain delivery receipts and device-takeover cleanup. No real provider request, browser permission grant, protected installation or production publication occurs in tests; these remain operator acceptance gates.

Measured private notification selection adds 255 bytes to firebaseClient.js after deduplicating its private-mode checks. Raise only that single-file source allowance by one KiB. Preserve the aggregate installation-cache budget, lazy notification implementation, art/network limits and production artifact validation; do not remove cached dependencies.
